purpose: Exploratory temporal replication on a third-party event-triggered price dataset; not a live trading policy
supersedes: v1 preserved; purge overlapping train observations and outcomes at the chronological boundary; no new signal tuning
split: Chronological by first observed snapshot; identical timestamps stay in the same partition
simultaneous_timestamps: Use last id at a timestamp for observation; require a strictly later entry timestamp
thresholds: Derived only from eligible decisions in the earlier partition after purging the final 85.2 seconds, fixed before later partition evaluation; no best-variant selection
missing: Keep absent decision/entry/exit separately; report full-loss sensitivity for missing exits, never fill forward prices
acceptance: No promotion from this dataset: event-triggered sampling, unverified reserve/fill availability, missing signed receipts and incomplete source coverage
